events.title: 421 Family Day
events.description: A family day of storytelling, sensory play and art-making inspired by the exhibition Archipelago of Whispers: a curator-led tour, then drop-in activities like making shakers and rainsticks, clay prints, shadow theatre and a reading corner with Arabic and English books. Lunch and carnival treats included; for all ages.

events.title: From Place to Belonging: How Art Shapes the Way Children Feel the World (ADMAF Talk)
events.description: Riwaq Al Fikr panel talk presented by Abu Dhabi Festival with the Public Art Abu Dhabi Biennial, with Dr. Dana Almazrouei, Hana El-Sagini, Iván Argote, Zainab Hasoon and Lisa Ball-Lechgar.
